notes: Run of 2026-11-11. Six Hoodline stories read: the library reopening, The Rustic and Mayer's Delicatessen earn entries; the Pacific Heights listing is declined; the Nutcracker XR and Clifford musical stories name no address.

findings.description: The Mission Branch Library, a 1915 Carnegie-funded building, reopens after a renovation begun August 2023; closed since March 2020. Reopening is scheduled for Saturday 14 November 2026, so the entry is dated by publication. The article attributes the design to G. Albert Lansburgh (spelled 'Lansburg' in the article).

citation.label: Hoodline, “Mission Branch Library Reopens Saturday After Three-Year Renovation,” 10 November 2026

raw.text: Mission Branch Library reopens its doors Saturday at 3359 24th Street

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 3359 24TH ST → parcel 6515001; sf-parcels has blklot 6515001 active, 3359–3359 24TH; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1900. The assessor files the parcel as 300 BARTLETT ST.

publish.note: One event, one entry: the reopening of the Mission Branch Library is already on /san-francisco/mission/bartlett-street/300/ from Mission Local, “After 6 years and $37 million, historic Mission Branch Library to reopen” (2026-10-09), and the reopening itself (14 November) has not yet happened. building.architect is already filled (Gustave Albert Lansburgh); nothing to add. Reopening date and renovation start kept in extra.

findings.description: The Rustic, a Cal-Italian restaurant that closed in September, reopened for dinner on Saturday (7 November) under new ownership. The new owner is a private individual and is not recorded.

citation.label: Hoodline, “Church & Market California-Italian Restaurant The Rustic Reopens Under New Ownership,” 10 November 2026

raw.text: The Rustic (215 Church Street) has reopened under new ownership

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 215 CHURCH ST → parcel 3544064; sf-parcels has blklot 3544064 active, 215–219 CHURCH; the 2025 roll records it as multi-family residential, built 1905. EAS puts 215, 217, 219 CHURCH ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 215.

publish.note: Entry on the existing page /san-francisco/castro/church-street/215/ (follows its 2026-09-29 closure entry) and card on the homepage grid. Nothing for the building block.

findings.description: Mayer's Delicatessen is being built out in the storefront at 641 Irving Street, vacant since Tart to Tart closed in 2022; construction nearing completion, opening expected early 2027.

citation.label: Hoodline, “Mayer’s Delicatessen Plans 2027 Inner Sunset Opening,” 10 November 2026

raw.text: Mayer’s is planned for 641 Irving St. in the Inner Sunset, in a space left vacant when Tart to Tart closed in 2022

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 641 IRVING ST → parcel 1762045; sf-parcels has blklot 1762045 active, 635–641 IRVING; the 2025 roll records it as multi-family residential, built 1923. EAS puts 635, 637, 639, 641 IRVING ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 635.

publish.note: Entry on the existing page /san-francisco/inner-sunset/irving-street/635/ (641 Irving resolves to the parcel's lowest number, 635) and card on the homepage grid. Nothing for the building block; the page's architect line is from its own 1923 record.

findings.description: A Pacific Heights mansion on Broadway listed for about $35M; the addresses printed are comparables named in passing, not the listing.

citation.label: Hoodline, “Pacific Heights Mansion Lists for $35M as Sisters Inherit 1890s Broadway Estate,” 10 November 2026

publish.note: Declined: a listing is not an event at the building, and the headline describes the private heirs who own it — current owners, whom the site never describes. The article prints no address for the Broadway listing; 2120 Washington Street (recorded here because the companion Chronicle story names it) and the Vallejo, Greenwich, Dealy and Cherry addresses are comparables named in passing, so the resolution above is to a comparable, not the listed house.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 2120 WASHINGTON ST → parcel 0602003; sf-parcels has blklot 0602003 active, 2120–2120 WASHINGTON; the 2025 roll records it as single family residential, built 1908.
resolution.note: No page at this path yet; the parcel is the publisher's to seed.
